name: laravel
label: Laravel application
description: A door into a Laravel application that has benjaminledel/covey-laravel installed: schema, read-only SQL and the application log behind a read token, tinker behind a write token.

versions.notes: First release. The manifest declares no webhook; a covey before 0.13.0 refuses it at upload (benjaminLedel/covey#542). The application side is the Composer package benjaminledel/covey-laravel 0.1.0.
